title: AI assists a computer-aided proof of the Reinhardt conjecture
summary: Fei Xue reports that the smoothed regular octagon minimizes optimal lattice-packing density among centrally symmetric convex disks in the plane.

evidence.tested: The preprint presents a finite reduction and computer-assisted checks.
evidence.unknown: Independent validation and an independently replayed certificate were not established in this review.
evidence.ai_role: ChatGPT explored local-cost lower bounds. The author credits GPT-6.1 Sol with the proofs for six remaining types.
